research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Blue River Technology is researching and developing agricultural machines that use image sensors, machine-learned models, and control systems to identify, treat, and monitor plants in fields. Their work includes plant identification using dynamic cropping, plant group identification, compensatory actions for automated farming machine failure, precision application of crop treatments with configurable nozzles, and plant treatment based on morphological and physiological measurements. These areas reflect a focus on automation, precision agriculture, and machine learning.

overview_description.description: Blue River Technology provides intelligent machinery that solves monumental challenges for customers. Their equipment uses see and spray technology to reduce the use of chemicals in food production by optimizing agricultural methods through robotics systems. Their systems automatically recognize plants and make decisions about which crop plants to thin or identify weeds to eliminate, enabling farmers to use methods for farming.
